subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should this PR proceed only after live Feishu/CardKit proof, or should a maintainer provide a proof override after sanctioned verification?
rationale: The contributor explicitly requested an override because they lack a Feishu tenant, but the PR changes visible channel message delivery and the current proof is helper-level rather than real behavior proof.

options.title: Require live Feishu/CardKit proof
options.body: Keep the proof gate in place until a redacted live run, logs, recording, or equivalent sanctioned artifact shows the fixed streaming card behavior after the helper defect is repaired.

options.title: Maintainer proof override after verification
options.body: A maintainer with Feishu access can run the scenario, document the result, and apply a proof override if the real card behavior is acceptable.

options.title: Fold into broader Feishu streaming work
options.body: Pause this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case resolved together with the broader Feishu streaming-card content-loss and duplication tracker.

recommendation.title: Require live Feishu/CardKit proof
recommendation.body: Keep the proof gate in place until a redacted live run, logs, recording, or equivalent sanctioned artifact shows the fixed streaming card behavior after the helper defect is repaired.

likelyOwner.reason: The PR is assigned to vincentkoc and recent current-main history shows work in the same Feishu dispatcher and streaming-card path.
